74112dc47f.caption:

3b4f6c6d2d.title: Veteran Tamil film music composer Deva passes away in Chennai at 75
3b4f6c6d2d.caption:
Legendary Tamil film music composer Deva has sadly passed away at the age of 75 in Chennai due to age-related health complications. Known widely as the "Thenisai Thendral," he revolutionized South Indian film music by introducing the Gana genre into mainstream Kollywood cinema during the 1990s. Throughout his illustrious career, he composed memorable tunes for over 400 films across Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada languages. Collaborating with top directors like Mani Ratnam, Rajinikanth, and Vijay, he delivered timeless chartbusters that remain fan favorites today. His immense contribution to cinema earned him numerous accolades, including the prestigious Tamil Nadu State Film Award. The entire South Indian film fraternity is mourning the profound loss of this iconic musical maestro.

#Deva #Kollywood #TamilCinema #MusicComposer #RIPDeva #SouthCinema

334755676f.title: Crazy Kalyanam Box Office Collection Day 1: Anupama Parameswaran's Film Registers Tollywood's 2nd Lowest Opening Of 2026
334755676f.caption:
Anupama Parameswaran's latest Telugu romantic comedy, Crazy Kalyanam, has registered a dull start at the box office. Released in theatres on Valentine's Day weekend, the film struggled to draw audiences on its opening day despite featuring popular lead actors. Trade reports indicate that the movie managed to earn only around 15 lakh rupees domestically on day one, making it one of the lowest Tollywood theatrical openings of the year. Directed by Kishore Tirumala and co-starring Siddhu Jonnalagadda in a special appearance alongside an ensemble cast, the film failed to generate substantial pre-release buzz. The comedy-drama received mixed to negative reviews from critics, which further dented its spot booking numbers. The makers are now hoping that positive word-of-mouth among youth and family audiences might spark a weekend recovery.

Key emotional and dramatic scenes from the 2006 Telugu psychological thriller film Shock are making the rounds on social media, drawing nostalgic praise from movie enthusiasts. Starring Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja alongside Jyothika in lead roles, the movie was directed by Harish Shankar in his directorial debut and produced by Ram Gopal Varma. Although the film had an experimental and dark tone that saw mixed box office results during its original theatrical release, viewers are now revisiting and appreciating the lead pair's intense performances.
